mapper.select: SELECT o.* FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC
SELECT o.* FROM orders o WHERE o.status = #{status} ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, order_code, status, total_amount, shipping_address, note, ordered_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderCode}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{shippingAddress}, #{note}, #{orderedAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{subtotal})
mapper.select: SELECT oi.*, p.name AS product_name FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
